caveats.statement: Some schools have missing or zero test takers, which can cause division by zero in excellence rate calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr = 0 OR NumTstTakr IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing or zero 12th grade enrollment, which can cause division by zero in test taker rate calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores WHERE enroll12 = 0 OR enroll12 IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing open dates, which can affect counts of schools opened in a given year.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE OpenDate IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing closed dates, which can affect counts of closed schools.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE ClosedDate IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing longitude or latitude, which can affect location-based queries.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NULL OR Latitude IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing administrator first names, which can affect queries filtering by administrator.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing website or email information, which can affect queries for valid email addresses.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Website IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some schools have missing ZIP codes, which can affect address completeness.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Zip IS NULL;
